name: @gateforge/pack-webhook
description: Webhook contract pack: TS-only detector for webhook endpoint patterns (Express router.post('/webhook'|'/hook'|'/callback'), Fastify/Hono equivalents, @webhook/@on decorator) emitting webhook.endpoint resources with signature/replay/retry attributes; loopback example server with HMAC-SHA256 verification, timestamp anti-replay, in-memory delivery dedup, bounded retries to prove five obligation contracts end-to-end.
